div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://mitre.org/fhir/space-health/CodeSystem/planetary-protection-category-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Missions to target bodies not of direct interest for understanding chemical evolution or origin of life (e.g., undifferentiated metamorphosed asteroids)
Missions to target bodies of significant interest but low contamination concern (e.g., comets, Jupiter, Saturn)
Flyby and orbiter missions to target bodies of chemical evolution and/or origin-of-life interest (e.g., Mars, Europa)
Lander and probe missions to target bodies of chemical evolution and/or origin-of-life interest
All Earth-return missions; subcategories for restricted and unrestricted return
